title: Apply-time answer families bind the six elicits to the upload contract
description: When the applying project answers the six apply-time elicits, the surface honours each with a runtime clause per family: `blueprint.json.elicits[id=accepted-set]` populates the MIME-type gate; `blueprint.json.elicits[id=size-cap]` populates the per-file byte cap; `blueprint.json.elicits[id=tick-interval]` sets the internal progress polling cadence (owned by `TAC-2403.interfaces.tickInterval`, internal only, not user-observable); `blueprint.json.elicits[id=concurrency]` sets the chunk upload parallelism on the transport TAC; `blueprint.json.elicits[id=polling]` caps the polite live-region announcement cadence (owned by `TAC-2403.interfaces.announcementInterval`); `blueprint.json.elicits[id=chunked-transport]` picks the multipart or tus branch on the transport TAC.
rationale: The six apply-time answer families named in the guide and ADR-2402 needed one must REQ per family so a project cannot elicit a value and see it ignored silently.
